"AppLock" for android, iPhone and Computer.

- Introduction
- information about application (H2 title)
- Versions available for download (H2 title)
- Important tips for beginners (H2 title)
- Features (H2 title)
- Frequently Asked Questions (H2 title)
- Conclusion of 75 words
Notes:
- Type with English United State language
- Keep Content compatible with Yoast SEO WordPress plugin

judge_reasoning: Candidate 3 best satisfies the required article structure by using clear Introduction plus H2-style sections for application info, versions, tips, features, and FAQ, whereas candidates 1/2/4 mostly use plain/bold headings instead of explicit H2 sections. Candidate 1 is closer on the “~75-word conclusion” requirement, but its section formatting and overall structural compliance are weaker than 3. Candidate 4 includes many highly specific product claims (e.g., download counts, iOS availability/alternatives, star rating, exact pricing) that are likely hallucinated and reduce trustworthiness.
